picked.angle: The first results of Algarve Evolution's AI adoption survey of Algarve businesses, which the article said had not been found.
picked.publisher: Algarve Evolution (the association that ran the survey)
figures_the_curator_read_at_source: 89 businesses; collected 7 Oct to 12 Nov 2026; first wave, repeated every six months
56 of 89 (63%) use AI regularly or built in (27 built in, 29 regular use)
35 accommodation businesses (39% of the sample): 43% regular or built in, against 63% in other sectors and 100% of the 19 in consulting and technology; 10 of the 35 do not use it
82% say the team is open to AI, 75% that management knows where it can help; 54% have rules on what goes into the tools; 38% have budget set aside for the next 12 months
picked.must_repeat_the_page's_own_caveat: respondents chose to take part, so the sample does not represent all Algarve businesses; 74% have fewer than 10 people and 39% are in accommodation; adoption is probably higher than the regional average
